channels.name: Global Pharmacy Entrepreneurs
channels.description: Created by Australian pharmacist Allie Xu — 'Pharmacy Entrepreneur TV' interviews pharmacy entrepreneurs from around the world about building a business and life they love.
channels.verificationMethod: Cross-corroborated across 5+ independent sources (channel page, podcast interviews, LinkedIn, Apple Podcasts) all describing the same creator and channel ID.

channels.name: The Happy PharmD
channels.description: Dr. Alex Barker, PharmD — pharmacist career coaching, including pharmacists who've transitioned into entrepreneurship. Framing leans more 'career transition' than pure business-building, worth noting.
channels.verificationMethod: Confirmed via channel page plus independent corroboration (LinkedIn, Apple Podcasts, thehappypharmd.com). Real, active, well-established (2,000+ pharmacists coached).
